meta.description: 3D-printed uCT calibration phantom, 6 inserts, curved arrangement. Stratasys PolyJet.
meta.coordinate_system: Local STEP CS: origin at the low point of the arc cross-section (arc midpoint between rod 3 and 4). x: horizontal, y: vertical (positive = toward curvature center), z: rod long axis.

rod_radii_from_center_mm._note: Geringfuegige Radiusabweichung der mittleren Rods (0.5mm) ist CAD-Design, kein Fehler.

_arc_geometry._note_R85: R85 in der Zeichnung bezieht sich auf eine andere Referenz als den Stabmittelachsen-Bogen (R=87.5mm) oder den inneren Gehaeusebogen (r=80mm vom Zentrum 0,87.5).

meta._material_order_note: Stab 1 (µCT_6H_V1_100, geringstes CaHA) ist die am weitesten links liegende Stab (x=-45.393). Stab 6 (µCT_6H_V1_800, 100% RadioMatrix) ist rechts (x=+45.393). Zuordnung anhand Materialliste 1-6 von Robin Heilmann.

seed_hint: Rod order across the arc: 800 - 700 - 500 - 400 - 200 - 100. Seed 1 in the outer 100% RadioMatrix rod (brightest, at one end of the arc), seed 2 in the 4th rod counted from it (400). Place both seeds near the rod centre, mid-length.

seed_region_growing._note: Rods are only 10 mm in diameter and embedded in a VeroWhite housing (~100 HU). Without smoothing the 400 rod (~385 HU) leaks into the housing (BONE kernel noise SD ~85 HU).

_radius_note: radius_mm = segmentation core radius (3 mm). Real rods are Ø10 mm (STEP: R=5); 2 mm margin avoids partial volume with the housing.
_phantom_theory_note: Cross-calibrated against BDC-6H200 in clinical CT (7 scans S1-S7, 2026-11, S1 re-segmented; Phantom_Kalibrierung_uCT_6H_V1.xlsx). Hybrid: rods 100-700 from linear fit Ref_000..Ref_600 (as paper), rod 800 from linear fit Ref_000..Ref_800 (avoids extrapolation above Ref_600). sigma = u_total = sqrt(u_ref^2+SEM^2), u_ref 1.2 (fit A) / 1.5 (fit B); trueness not included. phantom_theory = STANDARD kernel (default), phantom_theory_bone used automatically when the volume name contains 'bone'.

housing._description: Gebogenes Gehaeuse. Bogenmittelpunkt (0, 87.5). Innenbogen r=80mm, Aussenbogen r=95mm, Wandstaerke im Zentrum 15mm. Laenge z: -35..+35 mm.
